UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public advertiser profile linked to a Firebase Auth user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name of the founder or advertiser.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing the user's email and PayPal settlement email.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

paypalEmail.description: PayPal email for instant displacement refunds and cash-out payouts.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when private info was updated.

AuthorizedDomainRecord.title: AuthorizedDomainRecord
AuthorizedDomainRecord.description: Tracked Vercel or custom deployment domain registered by the admin (imtyroon@gmail.com).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin.

domain.description: Hostname (e.g., hotseat.vercel.app) authorized for Firebase OAuth.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the domain record was added.

AdminPayPalSettings.title: AdminPayPalSettings
AdminPayPalSettings.description: Admin-only PayPal mode & non-secret integration metadata managed by imtyroon@gmail.com.

sandboxEnabled.description: Whether PayPal Sandbox mode is enabled.

clientIdPrefix.description: Non-secret prefix of the configured PayPal Client ID.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin settings were updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Public advertiser profile documents indexed by Firebase UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Strictly owner-only PII subcollection storing email and PayPal payout email.

/users/{userId}/domains/{domainId}.description: Admin-managed list of Vercel and custom domains configured for OAuth.

/admin/{docId}.description: Admin-only platform settings restricted to imtyroon@gmail.com.
